The new index.html is definitely deployed—the FitFuel Family header is from the new version. But the login form isn't rendering, so the JavaScript is stopping before loginPage() completes.

I found the likely bug in the version we deployed: loginPage() calls header(), and header() assumes s.profile is always an object. During logged-out initialization, that isn't guaranteed after the session response. That can stop the script and leave exactly the blank screen you're seeing.

So don't change the database or Hostinger configuration. This looks like a front-end initialization bug, not a failed deployment.

I'll fix the logged-out initialization defensively and we can push a small patch through GitHub.

I found the actual cause. It wasn't the logged-out profile handling I first suspected—there were two JavaScript syntax errors in the deployed index.html. Because the browser couldn't parse the script at all, it displayed the header and then stopped, producing the blank page you saw.

Replace it and push the fix

and replace the existing index.html.
